releaseNotes: PS-200 extraction with complete Fractured Order decision Forms; configurable Industry cells with per-cell Strategic Orientation and per-move Proposal gates; unbounded Team Scribe and Facilitator seats; explicit Action revision and resubmission custody; recipient-isolated proposal negotiation whose accepted terms can be bound into Blue and Red Actions; accessible Facilitator presentation mode; Release-owned Statecraft Simulation Group attribution, logo, login artwork, and session deck; and Game Master terminology, readiness, evidence access, and Operator controls without a Participant Seat. Intercom and Session Recorder remain unbound until approved Plugin Artifacts, immutable digests, and Organization installation IDs exist.

sessionRoles.name: Scribe
sessionRoles.description: Team-authoring role. Scribes create and revise their own Team's decision Artifacts, then submit them into Team Facilitator custody. They cannot forward to White Cell or see another Team's private work.
responsibilities: Capture the Team's Strategic Orientation, Action, Response, Proposal, Industry plan or turn sheet in the exact Release-defined Form.
Save drafts and preserve field-level validation errors without transferring custody.
Submit or resubmit the current version to a Facilitator assigned to the same Team.
Revise only after the owning Team's Facilitator or White Cell returns the Artifact with review notes.
For proposal recipient threads, read the proposing Team's isolated thread and draft the Team's response; the Team Facilitator remains accountable for the response Command.

sessionRoles.name: Facilitator
sessionRoles.description: Team review and handoff role. Facilitators receive submitted work from their own Team's Scribes, return it for revision or forward it to White Cell, issue RFIs, and act for their Team in recipient-isolated proposal threads.
responsibilities: Review only Artifacts owned by the Facilitator's active Team and either return them with notes or forward the same version to White Cell.
Submit and clarify RFIs between the active Team and White Cell.
When the active Team is a named proposal recipient, accept, reject as Not Interested, or negotiate in that Team's isolated append-only thread.
When the active Team originated a proposal, reply to negotiation rounds and explicitly close each recipient thread.
Never inspect another recipient's proposal thread unless also assigned to that recipient Team or acting as White Cell.

sessionRoles.name: White Cell
sessionRoles.description: Control and custody role. White Cell operates Stages and timers, reviews submitted Artifacts, returns or accepts them, separately approves every proposal recipient and every negotiation message, answers RFIs, releases Injects, and records Control Interventions.
responsibilities: Hold submitted Artifacts after a Team Facilitator forwards them and preserve their immutable version history.
Accept ordinary decision Artifacts as complete or return them to the owning Team with required notes.
For proposals, approve or withhold forwarding independently for every named recipient Team.
Review every recipient response and negotiation round before forwarding it to the other side; White Cell can see all isolated threads but cannot silently rewrite them.
Answer or return RFIs, operate Stages and timers, release Injects, and record every override as a Control Intervention.
